name: Cambodia (UNTAC, 1992–1993)
description: A light blue field with a white map of Cambodia in the centre inscribed with the country's name in Khmer script.
history: Flag of the United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia, flown during the 1992–1993 transitional period alongside the flag of the State of Cambodia. After the Constituent Assembly election of 1993 the 1948 flag was readopted in June and the monarchy restored on 24 September 1993.

features.role: map of Cambodia with Khmer inscription
